business_problem: The Royal Concertgebouw Orchestra needed to engage younger audiences, reinvent traditional music learning, and keep classical music relevant to the next generation of concert-goers.
solution_summary: Accenture Song helped the Royal Concertgebouw Orchestra build Final Score, a Roblox role-playing game for ages 11 to 17, using generative AI as a working part of delivery rather than as a marketing add-on. The implementation combined domain content from the orchestra—original music, sound effects, and education goals—with a multidisciplinary workflow spanning design, world-building, development, testing, and launch. Copilot 365 was used to accelerate project-management tasks such as writing user stories, while Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, and bespoke ChatGPT models were used to generate 2D visual concepts and storylines for the game. Developers and creatives then refined those outputs into the Roblox experience served to players. More than 50 young people were kept in the loop throughout development as a feedback input for iteration and testing. The source does not disclose a named storage tier or back-end data platform, so the visible architecture centers on AI-assisted content creation and delivery through Roblox.
